DECISION: Two categories of org features with different activation models:

DECISION: manual_payments_enabled is a per-org boolean flag in org_features table, toggled via /admin UI. optional_student_contacts is hardcoded always-on for all orgs (no toggle).

OPTIONS CONSIDERED:
- Make both toggleable — rejected, optional contacts is universal behavior
- Make both hardcoded — rejected, some orgs may still want Stripe payments
- Current split — accepted

REASONING: Manual payments is a per-org billing model choice (some orgs use Stripe, some invoice manually). Optional student contacts is just UX — no org would want to hide contact info.

REVISIT WHEN: A new org feature is added — decide which category it falls into based on whether it's billing/commercial (→ toggle) or UX/workflow (→ hardcoded).

IMPLEMENTATION: `org_features` table has `manual_payments_enabled` bool. SendPackageModal checks `org?.manual_payments_enabled` to decide routing (Stripe vs manual API).
